theme.title: Down 3–1
theme.subtitle: 2016 Finals, Cleveland vs Golden State
theme.recap: Cleveland won the last three games, with LeBron James and Kyrie Irving scoring 41 each in Game 5 and the two teams dead level on points before Game 7.

questions.prompt: In Game 5 of the 2016 Finals, LeBron James and Kyrie Irving each scored how many points?
questions.context: 2016 NBA Finals · Game 5 · at Golden State
questions.note: 41 apiece, the first teammates to both reach 40 in a Finals game.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: James and Irving each scored 41 points to become the first teammates in Finals history to score 40 or more

questions.prompt: What was LeBron James's scoring average in the 2016 Finals, when he was named MVP?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: after averaging 29.7 points, 11.3 rebounds, 8.9 assists, 2.6 steals, and 2.3 blocks.
